source_reviews.independent_solution: Seed and actual figures were read first and the solution saved before author disclosure. Lq''+q/C=0 gives ideal LC f0=1/(2*pi*sqrt(LC)); hence lambda=c/f0=2*pi*c*sqrt(LC). Convert 12 pF to 1.2e-11 F and 450 pF to 4.5e-10 F. For L=2e-4 H and c=3e8 m/s the independently calculated limits are 92.34358777165421 and 565.4866776461628 m. H*F=s^2, so the wavelength unit is metres. Wavelength increases strictly with positive C: 12 pF yields the shortest and 450 pF the longest. Continuous included settings yield the full closed interval; its one-decimal approximate bounds are 92.3 and 565.5 m. The downstream fixed detector capacitor is not the specified tuning C. Neither the author's standard nor key supplied this truth basis.
